quotiēns

relative adverb, with the indicative; answered by totiēns

whenever, as often as

In this lexicon

  • whenever

    the recommended word · classical · Mart. 12.57.28: dormīre quotiēns libuit, īmus ad vīllam; Sen. Ep. 13.2: quī quotiēns cecidit contumācior resurrēxit

Examples
